Author: @joshhardin666
Content: in my opinion the best reason to have a pcie5 motherboard and a pcie5 gpu is that cpus don't give you enough pcie lanes to add additional hardware.  given that 8 pcie5 lanes operates at the same bandwidth as 16 pcie 4 lanes, if you get a pcie5 gpu and motherboard you can use a SECOND pcie device without sacreficing bandwidth to your gpu.  for example a multi 4k60 hdmi capture card, or a second gpu for use as an ai accelerator or a dual pcie5 m.2 adapter or a sas or sata hba so you can shove a bunch of disk in the system, etc. etc.
